tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Queue one job. Preserve session and key across network retries with identical inputs. A new key starts new work. Returns immediately; use get_job for its outcome.

files.description: Relative file paths to base64 bytes (8 MiB total).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read owned job status and bounded output. Unknown requires operator recovery.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Read this client's jobs, optionally within a session. Sessions group and serialize jobs; they do not automatically share files or model history.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation. This cannot undo effects; started work may become unknown.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read up to 1 MiB of an owned job file beneath work/ or team/, as base64. Live files may change between reads.
